title:
Some of our tenants who safely arrived at our activity centre, despite the snow ⛄️ ⛄️

Here are some tips for staying safe in snow and maintaining your mental health ❄️ ❄️❄️

Stay warm: Cold can make you more depressed, so wear layers of loose-fitting, lightweight clothing. Bright colors can also help lift your mood. Keep your home between 18°C and 21°C (or 64°F and 70°F degrees). 

Get enough sleep: Aim for 7 to 8 hours of sleep per night to feel less stressed and more energetic. 

Go outside: Sunlight can boost your mood, so go outside every day you can. You can try winter activities like building a snowman. 

Stay connected: Spending too much time alone can lead to anxiety and unhelpful thinking patterns. Try to spend time with friends. 
Practice mindfulness: Mindfulness can help maintain your mental health 

Stay safe everyone 

#bluepitshousingaction #snow
